text: Let's make a cosy hay tower! Big at the bottom, then middle, then little.
Now for a soft bed! Rub the loose bedding to make it nice and fluffy.
Oh, look! Your friend has a lovely cosy place to rest. Well done!
A neighbour needs our help! Look at the picture list, and pack their basket.
Let's weigh your harvest! Move your finger gently over the basket, and watch the little arrow.
All ready! Carry your lovely basket over to your neighbour.
Let's put the farm picture back together! Tap a piece next to the empty space, or slide it across. Look at the little picture to help you.
